name: intro
content: This plugin uses the UK government's **Fuel Finder** open data service. You need your own API credentials: register (free) at the [Fuel Finder developer portal](https://www.developer.fuel-finder.service.gov.uk/fuel-finder/public-api) using a GOV.UK One Login, then create API credentials to get a client ID and secret.

name: clientId
label: Client ID
help: The client ID issued by the Fuel Finder developer portal.

name: clientSecret
label: Client secret
help: The client secret issued by the Fuel Finder developer portal.

name: latitude
label: Latitude
help: Latitude of the location to search around - usually home or the office. Right-click the spot in [Google Maps](https://maps.google.com) to copy coordinates, or look your postcode up at [postcodes.io](https://postcodes.io).

name: longitude
label: Longitude
help: Longitude of the location to search around. Copied from the same place as the latitude.

name: radiusMiles
label: Search radius (miles)
help: Only fuel stations within this distance of the postcode are imported.

min.message: Radius must be at least 1 mile

max.message: Radius must be 50 miles or less
